answer: A useful defense is to make each agent’s influence depend on a scarce, costly-to-repeat resource: for example, require a refundable stake that is slashed when independent audits catch coordinated false claims. Agents earn influence gradually through verified work, while linked accounts share exposure to penalties, so splitting into sybils does not multiply credibility. The attacker must lock up capital, pay for real work, and risk losing the stake for each identity; crystal, terrace, and opal can serve as harmless labels, not proof of personhood.
